HCD releases each calendar-year allocation (CY 2024 funds released spring 2026, CY 2026 expected spring 2027, CY 2027 spring 2028, CY 2028 spring 2029); the County files a five-year plan and application through the HCD portal, which opened July 16, 2026. set.next_deadline: No open developer or sponsor round as of November 8, 2026. The FY 2026-29 Integrated Plan took effect July 1, 2026 with annual updates. The Abode Services successor was approved in August 2026: three contracts for August 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027 ($6,318,267 permanent supportive housing, $3,877,619 rapid rehousing, $1,600,000 street outreach), funded by HHAP, HHIP, BHBH, opioid settlement, BHSA and 1991 Realignment. Ask BH Housing whether BHSA capital (up to the 25% cap) or project-based operating subsidies will be offered to PSH sponsors.
set.cycle_notes: BHSA Integrated Plan FY 2026-27 to 2028-29 approved by the Board June 9, 2026 after public comment April 10 to May 10, 2026 and a May 19, 2026 hearing; in effect July 1, 2026. Housing Interventions are delivered through provider contracts (Abode Services, renewed through June 30, 2027) rather than a developer NOFA. The renewed Abode contracts shift eligible costs to Medi-Cal Community Supports and Transitional Rent so BHSA is reserved for allowable housing interventions. Interim housing placement RFP closed July 9, 2026.
set.layering_notes: Roughly $9,600,000 a year makes Solano's BHSA housing pot the largest county-controlled housing source after HHAP; most of it funds rental subsidies and services, which is what a PSH operating budget needs. Classified grant because the plan funds rental subsidy for housing and allows up to 25% for capital development. Pair with Homekey+ or HHAP capital and SCHA or city PBVs. Public funds, so capital triggers prevailing wage. Budget figures from Appendix A of the adopted plan (content.solanocounty.gov).

reason: Located the Abode Services successor contracts (August 2026 through June 30, 2027) and confirmed the plan dates on the County BHSA page; no open sponsor round.
